نضطرب (form VIII)
# نَضْطَرِبُ (naḍṭaribu) /nadˤ.tˤa.ri.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِضْطَرَبَ (iḍṭaraba)
# نَضْطَرِبَ (naḍṭariba) /nadˤ.tˤa.ri.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِضْطَرَبَ (iḍṭaraba)
# نَضْطَرِبْ (naḍṭarib) /nadˤ.tˤa.rib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِضْطَرَبَ (iḍṭaraba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
